## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Púsà Shì jīng* (T528) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by Bái Fǎzǔ 白法祖 ([白法祖](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%99%BD%E6%B3%95%E7%A5%96)). It is a parallel translation to [KR6i0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0157) *Shì tóngzǐ jīng* (T527) by Zhī Fǎdù — both render the same Indic narrative about a boy named *Shì* (Sanskrit *Jiyaka*?) who is given Buddhahood-prediction.

**Abstract**

The two parallel translations [KR6i0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0157) and [KR6i0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0158) preserve the early Western Jìn Chinese reception of this narrative. Bái Fǎzǔ was a Bái 白 clan monk active in the early Western Jìn at Cháng'ān; he is recorded as the translator of about 23 short texts. Translation dated to ca. 290–306 CE.
